name: rzmong-air-android
description: Aplikasi Android RZMONG Airsuspension (Capacitor) — membungkus web/control dengan BLE native + WiFi.

scripts.build: npm run bundle:ble && npm run copy:web

scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
